title: Pat Dorsey Returns -  The Moat Portfolio - [Invest Like the Best, EP.77]
summary:
And seemingly, every new tool and data source makes the problem even worse, adding more complexity, more headcount, and more risk. His areas of deep interest are

thesis: This episode argues that investors should focus on durable competitive advantages (moats) and be wary of capital misallocation, particularly in large tech companies like Meta. It highlights how low barriers to entry can destroy moats in specific sectors, such as textbook rentals, while noting that product fungibility and founder errors can lead to significant market share losses for companies like Uber.
